intervals.note: Earliest ANAIS document read (November 2001); the collaboration's founding date is not published. The official site (2026 news) shows the group still active (ANAIS+, analysis of the full ANAIS-112 exposure).
intervals.quote: ANAIS (Annual Modulation with NaI's) is an experiment planned to investigate seasonal modulation effects in the signal of galactic WIMPs using up to 107 kg of NaI(Tl) in the Canfranc Underground Laboratory (Spain).

website.quote: ANAIS is an experiment developed by the Nuclear Physics and Astroparticles group of the University of Zaragoza

name: ANAIS Collaboration
notes: No formation date, roster or member count was found; the Atlas records no memberships for this collaboration.

summary.plain: The Spanish team at the University of Zaragoza that built and runs ANAIS-112, nine sodium-iodide crystals in the Canfranc underground laboratory, to check a long-standing claim of a yearly dark matter signal made by the DAMA experiment.
summary.technical: ANAIS (Annual modulation with NaI Scintillators), an experiment developed by the Nuclear Physics and Astroparticles group (CAPA) of the University of Zaragoza at the Canfranc Underground Laboratory. Authors on the ANAIS-112 papers are from CAPA, University of Zaragoza and the Laboratorio Subterraneo de Canfranc. The next project, ANAIS+, is a cryogenic SiPM-readout R&D programme.
